Definition
[the transformations $\ell _{a,b}$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0117 ↗ lem:chow-ii-algebraic-curvature-decomposition 1. ch11:11.22\group Equivariant Curvature Transformations For $a,b\in \mathbb R$, define \[ \ell _{a,b}(R)=R+2(n-1)aR_I+(n-2)bR_{\operatorname {Rc}_0}. \] Thus $\ell _{a,b}$ multiplies the scalar, trace-free Ricci, and Weyl summands by $1+2(n-1)a$, $1+(n-2)b$, and $1$, respectively. It is invertible when the first two factors are nonzero.
